description: Speed step 1 (2026-10-11): the liquidity pass writes and reads its pools in batches, and a pass reads its candle window once. Each mutation is a way the faster path could stop being the same path: a batch that revives a terminal pool or chokes on a repeated id, a cache that outlives its pass or is never used. Needs Docker for the Postgres half. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/speed_step1.json

mutations.name: the batch upsert revives a terminal pool
a repeated pool id is sent twice in one statement
a batch beyond one chunk is cut short
get_many returns an entry for an id with no row
inside a pass every read still goes to the database
mutations.old:
if cache is None:
            return await self._inner.fetch_series(symbol, timeframe, start, end)
mutations.new:
if True:
            return await self._inner.fetch_series(symbol, timeframe, start, end)

mutations.name: the window is keyed without its end, so a shorter read is served the longer one
